name: Popcorn tub
summary: Red-and-white striped paper popcorn tub overflowing with puffed popcorn; for cinema, party and movie-night scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the tub rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the tub is hero size (~460 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: stripeColor
params.note: stripe colour (the other stripes are white)

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
